source.name: Innerscene Frame Stand - Picture Frame
source.authored_source_geometry: The source is a generic blank picture frame with glazing, an insert, rear strut, and easel cord; its embedded description reports units meters and geometry-derived source dimensions.

adaptation.creator: Vrooli
adaptation.license: CC0-1.0 for retained CC0 source portions; AGPL-3.0-only for Vrooli-authored wall cleat and candidate integration
adaptation.screen: Replace only mesh 7 material 4 with an appended neutral display material; append and reference a private TEXCOORD_0 accessor normalizing only screen-mesh-7 referenced UVs to [0,1]. The original binary chunk remains an exact prefix. The previous source UV accessor remains intact. The wall v3 hierarchy compacts only nodes made unreachable by removing the easel.

tabletop.pose: Retain the source rear easel strut and limiting cord; candidate tabletop use only.

wall.pose: Remove the source easel cord/strut nodes from the active hierarchy, compact remaining reachable node indices, and add a generic Vrooli-authored rear cleat. All source mesh/material records and original BIN bytes remain; candidate wall-supported use only. No wall fastener or load rating is represented.

qualification_limits: This adapts a generic picture frame into an electronic-display concept; it is not an Innerscene electronic product or measured digital frame.
The source preview and GLB dimensions are not independent physical measurements. Exact contact, stability, wall anchoring, active pixels, and product fit remain unqualified.
